title: Recursive Descent Parser - Operator Precedence & Associativity Invariants
failure_mode: LLMs build Pratt/recursive descent parsers that violate operator precedence or right-associativity for exponentiation, producing wrong evaluation order
invariant_guarantee: AST evaluation order strictly matches standard mathematical precedence (* > + ) and right-to-left associativity for ** (exponentiation), verified by exhaustive property testing against Python's own eval()
